submitted.rationale: Of the three measured compositions, index 10 (Bi0.07 Cu0.46 V0.47, a Cu:V ≈ 1:1 copper-vanadate-like region) gave the highest photocurrent, 2.75e-5 A. That is about 15x higher than the BiVO4-like and more Cu-rich compositions.

rejected.reason: Measured 1.81e-6 A. The BiVO4-like Bi/V-rich composition, even with Cu present, performed poorly.
Measured 1.9e-6 A. Raising Cu:V to about 1.4 made the photocurrent collapse.
